seo.title: Ministries
seo.description: Explore Bible study, children's, young adult, women's, men's, worship, dance, and creative arts ministries at Temple Aviv Judea.

hero.title: Bring your gifts. Find your people.
hero.intro: Community grows when we pray together, learn together, create together, and serve one another beyond Shabbat morning.

ministryCards.imageAlt: Mosaic-style illustration of five children reading together
ministryCards.title: Children
ministryCards.body: Shabbat School gives children a dedicated time to learn important truths from G-d’s Word in a caring setting suited to their age.

ministryCards.imageAlt: Mosaic-style illustration of young adults gathered together
ministryCards.title: Young Adults
ministryCards.body: A place to build lasting friendships, deepen faith, and discover how to serve G-d with clarity and courage.

ministryCards.imageAlt: Mosaic-style illustration of women and men gathered in fellowship
ministryCards.title: Women & Men
ministryCards.body: Fellowship, prayer, food, encouragement, and honest conversation create space to grow together through every season.

ministryCards.imageAlt: Mosaic artwork of a Messianic Jewish congregation participating in Davidic dance
ministryCards.title: Music & Davidic Dance
ministryCards.body: Musicians, singers, and dancers help lead expressive Messianic Jewish worship rooted in Scripture and rich tradition. Music is led by Josué Quan and David Pierce, and Davidic dance is led by Marianne Wegener.

bibleStudy.heading: Wednesday Bible Study
bibleStudy.body: Join our online Bible study on Wednesday evenings at 7:00 PM. Contact us to request the Zoom invitation and receive study updates.

artistFeature.heading: Bring the stories of Scripture home.
artistFeature.body: Rabbi Corey’s wife, Hilary Sylvester, brings biblical stories of faith, courage, love, and purpose to life through colorful original art and hand-embellished canvas prints.

artworks.imageAlt: Ruth & Naomi by Hilary Sylvester, depicting two women in a vivid blue and gold palette
artworks.title: Ruth & Naomi

artworks.imageAlt: Moses & The Burning Bush by Hilary Sylvester, depicting Moses holding the tablets
artworks.title: Moses & The Burning Bush

callToAction.heading: Start with one Shabbat.
callToAction.body: Meet the people, share a meal, and discover where your gifts can come alive.
